set.body: Source-inspection follow-up from bd-01M477F67P8ZJKHSCWSPCECG85. modules/hrf/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/hrf/regressor/NeuralInput.scala still computes floor((end-from)/resolution).toInt + 1 and then allocates two arrays. The completed sampled-convolution fix guards its internal drive builder but does not cover this separate public neuralInput preview API. Reuse a documented portable grid budget, validate finite derived ranges and positive resolution before conversion/allocation, provide a typed boundary with legacy facade compatibility, and retain existing pulse/scaling semantics. Add bounded threshold/overflow regressions on JVM+JS plus safe mutation evidence. No deliberately oversized NeuralInput allocation was attempted; this is a source finding.
set.title: Bound NeuralInput preview grids before integer conversion and allocation
